sloka: राक्षसैः सहितैर् नूनम् सीताया ईप्सितो वधः ।कांचनः च मृगो भूत्वा व्यपनीय आश्रमात् तु माम् ॥३-५७-७॥
transliteration: rākṣasaiḥ sahitair nūnam sītāyā īpsito vadhaḥ ।kāṁcanaḥ ca mṛgo bhūtvā vyapanīya āśramāt tu mām ॥3-57-7॥

translations.english: 'Hence the murder of Sita must have been jointly planned by the demons. Maricha who had assumed the form of a golden deer, took me away from the hermitage to a faroff place where, killed by my arrows, he turned a demon uttering the words, Alas, Lakshmana, I am killed.
